## What to look for

The one-minute visual comparison moves through paths, coverage, receiver motion, short corner routes and phase. The corner discussion begins at **00:37** and the phase discussion at **00:43**.

The local experiment uses the same physical minimum segment length in both engines and explicitly aligns selected geometry and field conventions. It illustrates why differences in defaults can change a comparison even when the rendered scenes look identical.

## Comparison scope

The accompanying local record limits the aligned comparison to CPU line-of-sight and specular paths, triangular meshes, isotropic antennas and a shared 3.5 GHz material snapshot. Geometry reconstruction is detached and does not provide geometry gradients.

Agreement on this room and trajectory is specific to this fixture and selected profiles. It does not establish that the two libraries are equivalent for all scenes or interactions.

## Reproduction material

The local delivery includes the editable Blender timeline, profile launchers, comparison evidence and source bundle. This website includes only the compact animation and poster. A future public case-study release should link the exact code, launch profile and numerical outputs together.
